svg.aria-label: Thirteen years, from the same starting event
svg.text: Thirteen years, from the same starting event
Five years, and article 15(4) counts the wait for the permit inside them
Filed after 19 May: EU and Portuguese-speaking countries
Seven years, and the wait is no longer inside them
Filed after 19 May: every other nationality
Ten years, and the wait is no longer inside them
Three years is the upper end of the permit wait. At the lower end every bar shortens and the gap does not.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 7 September 2026
